Hydro Flask collab flasks with onsite engraving; Coffee Supreme served coffee on the beach with collab cups and bags (https://www.instagram.com/p/DXtBtKHD64J/); Lexus-presented highlight videos; Rhythm Party Wave named heat.

notes: 12th edition 26 to 29 Mar 2026; 2027 (13th) teased but undated. Rich, values-led sponsor roster: Coffee Supreme as major partner, Hydro Flask six years running, Lexus, Rhythm, Sun Bum (sunscreen, a health-adjacent category) and Clean Collective. Organiser pitches sponsors on an 'authentically engaged audience'; mental health is a stated cause. Archibalds entries already in the record (2024, 2025) still stand.
